summary: Complete testing of Professional Inventory Management System. Backend: 16/16 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All UI elements verified including stats cards, tabs, products table, movements with type badges, warehouses, and modals.

GET /api/inventory/warehouses.details: Returns list of warehouses with id, code, name, is_default fields

POST /api/inventory/warehouses.details: Creates warehouse with code, name, address, is_default, allow_negative

POST /api/inventory/categories.details: Creates category with code, name, parent_id support

GET /api/inventory/units.details: Returns default units (PCS, KG, M, L, BOX, PACK) auto-created on first fetch

GET /api/inventory/products.details: Returns products with stock info, total_stock, is_low_stock calculated

POST /api/inventory/products.details: Creates product with barcode, SKU, reorder_level, min_stock, max_stock

GET /api/inventory/movements.details: Returns movements with movement_number, movement_type, quantity, balance_before/after

POST /api/inventory/movements (opening).details: Creates opening balance movement, updates stock correctly

POST /api/inventory/movements (sales).details: Creates sales movement, decreases stock, validates available quantity

GET /api/inventory/stocks/summary.details: Returns total_value, total_products, low_stock_count, expiring_soon, warehouses_count

GET /api/inventory/reports/stock-balance.details: Returns stock balance report with totals (total_items, total_value, low_stock_items)

GET /api/inventory/reports/low-stock.details: Returns items below reorder level with current_qty, reorder_level, shortage

Authentication tests.details: All endpoints correctly return 401 without authentication

inventory_page_load.details: Inventory Management page loads via sidebar navigation

stats_cards.details: 4 stats cards displayed: Total Stock Value (2,421,500), Total Products (2), Low Stock (0), Expiring Soon (0)

tabs_navigation.details: All 8 tabs present: Products, Warehouses, Categories, Units, Movements, Transfers, Adjustments, Reports

products_tab.details: Shows products table with Code, Name, Category, Quantity, Cost, Price, Status columns. Status badges (In Stock/Out of Stock) working

movements_tab.details: Shows movement history with Date, Type, Products, Warehouses, Quantity, Cost. Type badges (green for inward, red for outward)

warehouses_tab.details: Shows warehouse cards with code, name, address. Default warehouse marked with badge

add_product_modal.details: Modal opens with all fields: Code, Barcode, Name, Name (EN), Category, Unit, Cost, Price, Tax Rate %, Reorder Level, Min Stock, Max Stock, Has Expiry

add_movement_button.details: Add Movement button present and clickable

context_for_next_testing_agent: Inventory Management module fully tested. Access via Dashboard sidebar -> Inventory. Backend API prefix: /api/inventory. All CRUD operations working for warehouses, categories, products, movements. Stock is auto-updated when movements are created. Movement types: purchase, sales, transfer_in, transfer_out, adjustment_in, adjustment_out, return_in, return_out, damage, expired, opening.
